identity.normalizationNote: Packet entries already merge split synonyms (ID-2); every position cited is the normalized one-based position, identical to the packet index + 1.

preservatives: SELENIUM SULFIDE@15 (capped active, W-LINE class b)
formulaFacts.labelFact: Selenium sulfide: EU Annex III anti-dandruff-only active, max 1 % (DS1); informational only, no copy.

wLine.derivation: Alphabetical run 11 (2-OLEAMIDO-1,3-OCTADECANEDIOL) to 19 (TOCOPHERYL ACETATE): 9 ascending entries under the W-LINE comparison (digits sort before letters, so 2-OLEAMIDO@11 sorts before MENTHOL@10 and breaks the shorter run CARBOMER@7-MENTHOL@10). The run does not contain the earliest cleansing surfactant (SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE@2); its second entry PARFUM@12 is a candidate (class d) and is also the E3 marker (class a). No candidate precedes it. (i) SLES@2 before it; (ii) nothing between it and the cap -> plausible; W-line = cap = 12, no fallback code. Alternative reading (if the manufacturer's letter-sort of 2-OLEAMIDO is followed, run 7-19): tail candidate CI 19140@8, W-line 8. The formula has no payload_lipid, so either reading changes nothing.

cleansingStrength.rationale: moderate by C1: defining anionic SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE@2 (ether type) with the prominent buffer COCO-BETAINE@4 and no reinforcing strong anionic (the settled ether-sulfate-plus-betaine core).

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful conditioning system - prominent DIMETHICONE@6 - with light routes (pearlizing GLYCOL DISTEARATE@3, GLYCERIN@5, ceramide-type 2-OLEAMIDO-1,3-OCTADECANEDIOL@11). C2 is not met: there is no cationic polymer. Counter-signal: without a cationic deposition aid, silicone deposition from an SLES chassis may be limited, so low is the realistic neighbor.

weightPotential.rationale: moderate: one plausibly persistent system - prominent DIMETHICONE@6 - in an ordinary C1 SLES/betaine chassis (reset moderate); bounded residue is plausible. No cationic polymer or conditioner, no payload lipid (W-line PARFUM@12 gates nothing), so neither W-RICH nor the convergence route for high exists.

weak_refatter: 2-OLEAMIDO-1,3-OCTADECANEDIOL@11 (ceramide-type; if read as payload_lipid it would be material at 11 < W-line 12, which changes no route because reset is moderate and it sits after MENTHOL@10)
reset: SODIUM LAURETH SULFATE@2 (strong anionic, ether type)
excluded: CARBOMER@7 (anionic acrylate rheology polymer, suspends the selenium sulfide; 6.4)

weightPotential.counterevidence: No cationic polymer to aid silicone deposition; the second deposition family is only a trace ceramide-type additive after MENTHOL@10; moderate SLES reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: A prominent dimethicone is a plausibly persistent deposit; calling the product lightweight would understate the residue risk, while a single silicone without cationic aid and with moderate reset keeps it bounded.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: low rather than moderate would need the silicone to be light/late; it is the sixth entry, before Carbomer and the actives (W2: two families present, so "one light route" is not sufficient). high is excluded: one route kind only, no W-RICH.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Dimethicone deposition without cationic polymer is uncertain; realistic unknowns (silicone level, particle size) could move it to low.

focusPrimary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only, claims hidden): general. No claim direction is visible in the blind pass, so no specialist focus has a claim-plus-formula case yet (7.2 "unsupported/generic claims"). Formula care-direction verdict recorded for reconciliation: nonspecific. Formula-led route that could matter: recognized dandruff active SELENIUM SULFIDE@15 (DS1) with SALICYLIC ACID@14 and MENTHOL@10.

careDirection.limitation: No coherent humectant or damage-care cluster.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Claims hidden; the provisional value can change only through 3.2 reconciliation.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: null (blind). Formula compatible: n/a until a claim names a job. Decision: provisional general.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept: no exact-product positioning is visible in the blind pass (Section 8 condition 1 cannot be met).
focusSecondary.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): []. Secondary focus requires distinct exact-product positioning, hidden in the blind pass.

usageRole.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): regular, the default (Section 9). Every non-default trigger needs a moderate/high-graded claim or direction (CL-SRC), hidden in the blind pass. treatment becomes possible because dandruffSupport is supported (needs a qualifying E2 dandruff claim, U3); alternating impossible (not strong).

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: PROVISIONAL (formula-only): not_targeted, because SC1 positioning (an E2 sensitive/dry claim unit graded moderate/high) cannot be seen in the blind pass. Formula half (CSA) recorded for reconciliation: CSA would pass only through the humectant list (GLYCERIN@5 prominent); there is no E4 comfort route, so an S-SENSITIVE gate would fail. Counter-signals: prominent cooling agent MENTHOL@10; declared PARFUM@12.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: the complete INCI contains SELENIUM SULFIDE@15, a recognized anti-dandruff active (Section 11 table; DS1 for selenium sulfide). Formula-only property, final in the blind pass; whether a dandruff target is projected depends on the claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).

provisionalNotes: focusPrimary, focusSecondary, usageRole and scalpComfortTarget are claim-dependent and provisional (formula-only).
dandruffSupport supported via DS1 (selenium sulfide); a dandruff target depends on a qualifying E2 dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).
